core_idea: Research is never neutral. Traditional theory describes society as it is; critical theory asks whose interests that order serves and aims to free people from domination, including the ideologies that make domination look natural.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How do institutions, discourses or technologies reproduce domination?
Research that aims at emancipation, not only description.
Typical designs: critical discourse analysis, critical ethnography, participatory action research.
common_mistakes: Confusing Frankfurt School critical theory with critical thinking or critical realism.
Stating an emancipatory aim with no account of how the research contributes to it.
